title: CmdPal: Result factory drops fallbacks it was told to show

judgment.rationale: The one-line report names the result factory but not the query or fallback item. Current main intentionally filters blank-title fallbacks, so a concrete non-empty item that disappears is needed before a code fix can be justified.
evidence: The issue body only says “Result factory drops fallbacks it was told to show”; it contains no query, provider, item, or reproduction sequence.
Current upstream main at 2d28a562bfb5f8a76c4a43bbd8c3939f827bb368 filters empty-title fallback items before and during result creation.
The current result-factory tests cover merging and ordering, but the issue does not specify which case fails.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact query and fallback item/provider, including expected and actual results and whether its title is populated when it disappears.

fix_assessment.rationale: No particular code change is supported until the missing fallback and its title state are identified; this is a request for a discriminating reproduction, not a conclusion that the behavior is expected.

issue_context.summary: A CmdPal report says the result factory drops fallbacks, but identifies no query, provider, fallback item, or expected-versus-actual result.
known_information: The issue is labeled for Command Palette and reports version 0.102; its body contains only the one-line symptom.

Current upstream main at 2d28a562bfb5f8a76c4a43bbd8c3939f827bb368 filters blank-title fallback items in MainListPage before calling MainListPageResultFactory.Create and filters deferred fallbacks after scoring.
Current result-factory tests cover list merging, app limits, and fallback ordering, but the issue does not identify which input item is missing.
inferences: The behavior may be intentional suppression of an empty/deferred title or a separate loss of a non-empty fallback during refresh/merge; the present report cannot distinguish them.
issue_context.analysis: Current source has explicit empty-title filtering, but no clear path that drops a described non-empty fallback. Do not call the behavior expected or propose a code change until the missing item and query are identified.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live issue body and verified there were no comments or additional reproduction details.
Read MainListPage.GetSearchViewItems, ScoreDeferredFallbacks, MainListPageResultFactory.Create, and current result-factory unit tests from upstream main at 2d28a562bfb5f8a76c4a43bbd8c3939f827bb368.
Confirmed that empty-title fallbacks are intentionally filtered; no concrete non-empty input-to-output discrepancy can be established from the issue text.

information_gaps.information: The exact search query, missing fallback title/provider, and whether that fallback has a non-empty title when it disappears.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes the intentional blank-title filter from a real result-factory or refresh-path loss.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce on CmdPal 0.102 and provide the query, fallback/provider name, expected and actual visible list, and whether waiting or clearing/retyping changes the result.

comment.body: Could you share the exact CmdPal query, the fallback item/provider that is missing, and the expected versus actual result list? Please also say whether the item appears after waiting or after clearing and retyping, and whether its title is populated at that point. This will distinguish an intentional empty-title filter from a result-factory or refresh-path loss.

status.label: Needs reproduction
status.detail: The report does not identify which fallback disappears or under what query.

next_action.label: Request a focused fallback repro
next_action.reason: Identify the provider, query, item title, and expected versus actual output before selecting a fix.
